page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.E3.Flex.4-32 is a general-purpose virtual machine instance built on the x86_64 architecture. The server is powered by an AMD EPYC 7742 processor operating at a base clock frequency of 2.25 GHz. It provides 4 dedicated physical cores with 2 threads per core, offering 8 vCPUs alongside 32.0 GB of system memory.

The configuration provides a balanced 1:4 compute-to-memory allocation, supplying 4.0 GB of memory per core. The instance includes no integrated local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data storage and OS installation. Hardware acceleration is not present, with zero discrete GPUs. Network connectivity includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Because it pairs dedicated x86_64 CPU resources with standard memory capacity, this instance offers predictable computing performance without shared-core contention. It is suited for workloads such as application middleware, microservice hosting, continuous integration runners, and standard web serving environments.
